in_sanskrit.name: उषस
in_sanskrit.meaning: dawn, early morning, goddess of dawn
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The goddess of dawn, the goddess of the eastern direction, the goddess of the new beginning, the goddess of the light of consciousness, the one who dispels the darkness of ignorance, the wife of Lord Surya (the Sun God).

in_hindi.name: उषारानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The queen of the goddess of dawn. The name 'Usharani' is formed by combining the name of the goddess of dawn, 'Usha', and the suffix 'Rani' which means queen.

in_tamil.name: உசாரானி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The queen of the goddess Usha in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: ఉశారాని
in_telugu.long_meaning: The queen of the goddess Usha in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: UshaRani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dawn, radiant goddess
in_marathi.long_meaning: UshaRani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of the dawn, radiating light and joy

in_bengali.name: UshaRani
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Dawn, radiant goddess
